text: One PDF. Twelve study tools. Let me show you all of them in sixty seconds.
Wait, my lecture notes can do all that?
Open any PDF in Lumen's reader. It turns like a real book, and stays private on your device.
Draw with the pen. Highlight the key idea. Every mark is saved with its page.
Open Tools. Copy a region, magnify, add stickers, calculate, define a word, present, or export.
A magnifier follows your pointer, for diagrams and small print.
Drag clinical stickers onto the page. And a calculator with clinical formulas, right beside your notes.
Stuck on a word? Define it in plain language, with help in other languages too.
Turn your highlights and notes into slides to present, or export to PowerPoint, Word, or Markdown.
And the Study panel helps you recall before you reveal, with a quiz and summary from your own page.
It's like a study desk inside my PDF.
Bring your notes. Lumen does the rest. Try it free today, at Lumen dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
